en.bdb: Fire lits the lamp and light scatters in the darkness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਪਕ ਵਿਚਹੁਂ ਮਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਕੰਮ ਆਇ ਲਿਖੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: dheepak vichahu(n) mas hoi ka(n)m aai likhere|

en.bdb: The ink obtained from the lamp is used by the writer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਜਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: kajal hovai kaamanee sa(n)g bhale bhalere|

en.bdb: From that lamp women get collyrium.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਦਫਤਰ ਅਗਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: masavaanee har jas likhai dhafatar agalere|

en.bdb: With the same ink are written eulogies of the Lord and the clerk writes accounts in his office.
Only gurmukh realises this fact, that the Lord pervades all around.
